segment.source: Renders a boxed list of the few points a reader should leave with, each of them one line long. Use it for: the summary at the top of a long report, the recap at the end of a guide, the essentials above a legal text, an executive summary on a study page. Prefer 'Callout' for a single remark that needs a warning tone, and 'Pros and Cons' when the points fall into two opposed columns.
